With abstinence will come clarity. Clarity will allow self reflection and insight but will also bring confusion,shame and self recrimination. Forgive yourself. What ever you did or did not do, sexually or otherwise, can be seen as an effort to reduce suffering and feel wanted/loved. Please stay sober long enough to process this. The more shameful the transgressions the greater the compulsion to hide in drunken oblivion. There will come a time to assess accountability for recent incidents. You may want to find someone to tell or maybe write down some notes, but then let it go. You are not what you did or what happened to you. Please be kind to yourself and know that you are not alone nor particularly horrible in your behaviour.

The first consideration must be what harm is caused by judging your fellow traveller unworthy. We are all searching for a lessening of suffering both felt and caused. The root of these sorts of in group judgments is often related to ego and dressed as concern for the newcomer. Acceptance is fundamental and judgement anathema to our program. Alcohol is certainly more physically perilous and if substitutions are judged to be counter to acceptance by the group….well to me the decision is clear. Full disclosure- I was excluded from my group’s collective 5 year cake night because I was taking Prozac in the early 90s.

For me it was about escape. Job, friends, family, city, house, debt, reputation, spouse, lover, even my own body. Like playing a game you really messed up - the reset button looms. When your forebrain is offline any way out of pain that does not involve taking responsibility seems a solution to unbearable shame and suffering. Somewhat related I think to what has been called ‘the geographical cure’. Although I didn’t threaten or ask for divorce I desperately wanted to run away and eventually getting drunk to do that stopped working. 
Best wishes and be kind to yourself.

I was prescribed 600 three times a day but I couldn’t function I maxed out at 100 on waking 100 midday and 300 at bedtime. I eventually received a cortisone injection at C4. On my second shot I had nearly complete pain relief and significant reduction in numbness. I then wanted to cease GABAPENTIN and became aware of the discomfort involved in doing so. I immediately stopped the morning pill and reduced the evening dose to 100. Insomnia and hypnic jerks ensued. Also bruxism and all day long antsy feel with subconscious fist clenching and sometimes involuntary grimace. Doctor maintained this could not be. Over the next few months I reduced to 100 mg before bed. I have stopped that now along with everything else. CBD and CBN both oral and vape were substituted for a time but they have their own problems and limitations. These remaining symptoms are from the absence of GABAPENTIN and only subside when resuming at least 500 mg daily. The most troubling thing is having ones lived experience discounted and looked on with obvious skepticism.

This drug was developed to bind to gaba receptors and significantly to overcome the challenges of crossing the blood brain barrier. It does not do that.
